title: Helion Energy media frame
description: A stand-in for any photo or video: a flat muted surface with a soft glow wash rising from the bottom, taking its size, ratio and radius from the caller, or cropping a real image or video like object-fit cover. Optionally the contents settle from 110% to 100% as the frame scrolls into view.
notes: empty, it is aria-hidden and never draws the subject it replaces
tone="film" scopes itself `dark`, so it stays a dark surface on any page (for footage under light text)
the zoom is a CSS view timeline; off under reduced motion and where scroll timelines are missing
